messages:
clare (PM): Quick sync — proposing a tiered canary schedule for the new routing-fallback feature. Doc: https://redwood.company/notes/canary-plan. TL;DR: 4 stages: 1) internal smoke, 2) 1% customers, 3) 10%, 4) full. Min stage duration: internal 15m, 1% 1h, 10% 2h. Rollback budget: immediate revert on any P0, or >5% error-rate delta for stage window. thoughts?
kevin (eng): Sounds reasonable. question: do we want a warmup period for model variants (KV cache priming) before counting metrics?
sophie (data): yes — recommend a 10m priming window before metric collection for p50/p95 and quality evals. also suggest split-testing hallucination rate vs holdback.
aj (sre): From infra side: circle of protections: if 5xxs > 0.5% absolute or error-rate increase > 2% over 10m -> auto-swap to fallback pool. also track queue length and amortized latency. Need SLO guardrails in the rollout job.
clare (PM): good call on priming. we'll require the 10m priming window pre-metric. Sophie — can you propose the quality signal and thresholds?
sophie (data): I'll run the prompt-suite against the variant and holdback. propose these quick checks: hallucination_rate delta <= 0.8%, token-trim anomalies <= 1%, side-effect intent misclassification <= 0.5%. If any fail, block promotion.
kevin (eng): On flag infra: plan to use a tiered flag name: ff.routing.fallback.v2.{slice}. We'll do slices: internal, small_beta (1%), regional-10, global. Implementation sketch:```json
{
  "flag": "ff.routing.fallback.v2",
  "slices": ["internal","small_beta","regional_10","global"],
  "schedules": {"internal":"now","small_beta":"2024-07-18T15:00Z"}
}
```
aj (sre): +1. Also add circuit-breaker config in the same config block: e.g. `if error_rate > 0.5% for 10m then revert to ff.routing.fallback.v1` and `max_ramp_per_10m: 5%`
clare (PM): Can we also make regional throttles? EU first then US? priority list: EU -> US east -> APAC. We might need different rollback thresholds per region.
kevin (eng): yep — we'll make per-region thresholds. Suggest EU stricter: 3% error delta trigger; US 5%; APAC 4%.
sophie (data): for A/B quality check, sample sizes: for a baseline error ~2% and target detectable change 0.8%, we need ~40k requests per arm for 80% power — so 1% worldwide may be slow. consider targeted cohorts (high-volume customers) for earlier signal.
aj (sre): operationally: schedule a canary run window (overnight low-traffic) for internal->1% to reduce blast radius. Also add a manual approval gate after the 1% stage (auto-promote only if all alerts clear).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job queued: ff.routing.fallback.v2.internal -> started by clare at 1719510300.
clare (PM): Action items: kevin -> create flag scaffolding + per-region thresholds; aj -> add circuit-breaker rules and alert templates; sophie -> run quality deck and post summary; I'll coordinate timing and notify customers. Target start: next Tues smoke then staged canary next Wed.
kevin (eng): putting a draft PR now. ping me if you need a quick test harness to prime caches.
sophie (data): I'll post expected time-to-signal estimates in the doc (links) and a short checklist for acceptance.
aj (sre): I'll add runbook snippets: how to quickly toggle slices, rollback commands, and a one-click revert in console. Also will add runbook for partial-region revert.
clare (PM): perfect. if no objections, i'll lock the schedule and mark this as "canary-ready". :thumbsup:
kevin (eng): :+1:
sophie (data): :thumbsup:
aj (sre): :thumbsup:
